use_case: Pipeline leak-detection anomaly model: scores 1-minute pressure, flow, temperature, and valve data by segment and alerts controllers to possible leaks or ruptures
vendor_or_model: Anomaly model vendor (machine learning with mass-balance features), tuned on 24 months of company historian data; runs in the company workload on Cloud provider B (SYS-12)
data_categories: SCADA historian data (pressures, flows, temperatures, valve states); segment and telemetry metadata; no personal information
affects_individuals: No (indirectly: people who live, work, and travel along the pipelines)
human_in_the_loop: Advisory only. Alerts appear on a separate screen in the GCC-1 and GCC-2 control rooms; the controller checks SCADA trends and follows abnormal operation or emergency procedures; the model cannot write to SCADA or change alarms
applicable_laws: 49 CFR 192.615(a)(12) (rupture identification procedures name information sources); 49 CFR 192.631(c), (e)(5), (f)(3), (h); 192.705 and 192.706 unchanged; TSA SD Pipeline-2021-02G (SYS-12 is a Critical Cyber System); FTC Act Section 5 (vendor claims, indirect)
status: In production (advisory) on PS-1, PS-2, and JV-1 to JV-3; not used on PS-3
committee_review: Reviewed 2025-11-12; re-reviewed 2026-08-26 (full assessment in ai-risk-assessment.md section 6)
monitoring: Monthly simulated leak set; false alerts per shift; detection by segment group; data completeness by site

use_case: In-line inspection anomaly classification assistant that pre-classifies metal loss and dent indications for integrity engineers
data_categories: In-line inspection data; excavation and repair results; no personal information
human_in_the_loop: Integrity engineers review every classification; all indications meeting immediate or scheduled repair criteria are confirmed by an engineer before the response plan
applicable_laws: 49 CFR Part 192 integrity management (engineer remains responsible for anomaly evaluation); FTC Act Section 5 (vendor claims, indirect)
monitoring: Quarterly agreement rate between model and engineer calls; missed-indication review after every excavation

use_case: Right-of-way imagery change detection (satellite and aerial) that flags possible excavation or encroachment near the pipelines
business_owner: Vice President, Pipeline Safety and Compliance
data_categories: Satellite and aerial imagery of the right-of-way (may incidentally show people, vehicles, and homes)
affects_individuals: Potentially (incidental imagery; no individual is identified or targeted)
human_in_the_loop: Damage prevention analysts verify each alert before dispatching a patrol; patrols and one-call processes continue unchanged
applicable_laws: 49 CFR 192.705 patrols remain required; image retention under the records schedule
monitoring: Monthly precision on verified alerts; missed-event review after any third-party damage

use_case: Compressor predictive maintenance model that suggests inspection intervals for turbines and reciprocating units
data_categories: Unit vibration, temperature, and run-hour data; no personal information
human_in_the_loop: Engineers approve every interval change; manufacturer limits are enforced
applicable_laws: None AI-specific; covered by the maintenance standard (STD-01.6)
monitoring: Quarterly comparison of predicted and found conditions
